title: Truncated Multiple Zeta Values
summary: We generalize the definition of truncated multiple zeta values by allowing arbitrary integers as arguments. This leads to interesting identities, particularly with the argument 0. Truncated multiple zeta values satisfy the same quasi-shuffle algebraic identities as multiple zeta values, but we need to extend the algebra QSym of quasi-symmetric functions to a larger algebra.
